blinding_guess.why: All ten listed C API functions are declared in the public headers with RCL_ACTION_PUBLIC and defined in src with matching signatures; nothing in the snapshot looks inconsistent. The element set is the server-side call surface a client library uses, and the headers mark every one except rcl_action_publish_feedback as 'Thread-Safe | No', which could matter to a multi-threaded caller, but that is not visible as a defect from this package alone.

notes: Snapshot is the rcl repository root (rcl, rcl_action, rcl_lifecycle, rcl_yaml_param_parser); only snapshot/rcl_action was used. ros_distro is null in the packet, so no dependency definition files were fetched. All packet elements are C API symbols (side provides); none is a topic, service, action, message or field, so msg_type, frame, units, qos, rate and definition_id are null for every port (not applicable to a C function symbol, not undetermined). declares entries use the full declaration statement from the attribute macros (RCL_ACTION_PUBLIC RCL_WARN_UNUSED) through the terminating semicolon, whitespace collapsed to single spaces (newline after '(' becomes a space). Header 'Thread-Safe' attribute per function: accept_new_goal No (action_server.h:379); publish_feedback 'Yes [1]' (action_server.h:424); publish_status No (482); notify_goal_done No (635); take_cancel_request No (671); process_cancel_request No (715); send_cancel_response No (745); update_goal_state No (goal_handle.h:126); goal_handle_get_status No (176); goal_handle_is_active No (201). rcl_action_publish_feedback / rcl_action_publish_status publish on the server's feedback/status publishers whose QoS is taken from the rcl_action_server_options_t supplied by the caller at rcl_action_server_init; defaults in rcl_action_server_get_default_options (action_server.c:260-272): feedback_topic_qos = rmw_qos_profile_default, status_topic_qos = rcl_action_qos_profile_status_default (default_qos.h: KEEP_LAST 1, RELIABLE, TRANSIENT_LOCAL); cancel service uses rmw_qos_profile_services_default. These belong to the topics/services, not to the API elements, so they are not recorded in ports. Behavioural notes from the definitions: rcl_action_notify_goal_done only recalculates the expire timer (action_server.c:678-690); rcl_action_process_cancel_request does not change goal state, it fills cancel_response with goals to cancel (action_server.c:702-821); rcl_action_goal_handle_is_active returns true for ACCEPTED, EXECUTING, CANCELING (goal_handle.c:139-152); rcl_action_take_cancel_request maps RCL_RET_SERVICE_TAKE_FAILED to RCL_RET_ACTION_SERVER_TAKE_FAILED via TAKE_SERVICE_REQUEST (action_server.c:274-291). No packet element is consumed, so references is empty; not_declared is empty because all ten symbols are declared and defined.
